desc.zh: 从等宽陷阱推导最小结尾与二分更新。
desc.en: Derive minimal tails and binary search from the equal-width trap.

complexity: O(n log n) time; O(n) space

concepts.name: Equal-width ordering
concepts.description: Descending height ties reduce strict two-dimensional nesting to LIS.

concepts.name: Minimal tails invariant
concepts.description: First greater-or-equal replacement preserves best attainable ending heights.
